name: Aneimo 2 H's
source:
This is the fandisc of Aneimo 2.

One day, Takumi's father gives him an airline ticket to a southern island. He and his friends, Mizuki, Satsuki, Saori, Yui, and Kazumi, go there together. Who will he choose and spend time with? Their battle for Takumi now breaks up...

[From Himeya Shop]
